parsed.explanation: The inference |E|<|V| implies that the entire disconnected multigraph has no cycle or loop is false; a cyclic component may coexist with isolated vertices. Thus the component containing vertex n need not be a tree, so its asserted 2-colouring and the ensuing signed-sum bound are unjustified. No independent all-n lower-bound proof appears elsewhere. A local replacement can fix this: since the component edge counts sum to fewer than the vertex counts, some connected component has |E_T|<|V_T|; connectedness then forces that component to be a tree. Property (3.1) applies to its nonempty vertex set, so it need not contain n.
